identity.archetype: Ocean pressure / frontline peel / directional denial
identity.one_of_one_hook: An undead shipmaster shapes finite ocean pressure into moving currents and spectral kraken lanes rather than carrying a shield.
identity.silhouette_read: Low broad asymmetric wreck-hull shoulder, narrow drowned human skull in open brass pressure collar, hanging stern bell, torn short sailcoat, long single keel-oar; no hat, tentacle beard, crab claw, antlers, cape or shield.
identity.gameplay_promise: Protect an approach against ranged fire, pin a retreat line against displacement, and redirect enemies with telegraphed water currents; control space rather than heal or chase.
identity.counterplay: Flank the directional current, wait out finite Ballast, interrupt the planted stance, leave marked lanes, break line of sight; no forced environmental kills or repeated ultimate pulls.

design.visual_identity: Massive drowned undead human pirate captain in armor made from the wreck of his own ship: one curving ribbed teak-and-bronze shoulder prow, opposite skeletal hand and exposed iron ribs, translucent seawater held within a brass chest pressure cage, salt-cracked bone face with one pale sea-glass eye, stern bell and rope ties, torn slate sailcloth coat. No humanoid cephalopod face, familiar franchise costume, handheld shield or claw.
design.signature_prop: Keel Oar: a two-handed, broad blunt steering blade with tidal channels and a distinctive offset shaft, used to sweep and plant ocean currents. The spectral kraken is a separate abyssal creature, not his anatomy.
materials: Salt-pitted aged bronze and ship iron
Waterlogged teak with ribbed hull construction
Translucent contained sea water; controlled foam highlights
design.accessibility_notes: Readable broad silhouette and single oar from both cameras; patterned friendly/enemy current edges plus shape and audio cues; low-flash motion option; no opaque full-screen water, tentacle camera clipping or color-only targeting. Test real gameplay.

active_abilities.name: Keelstroke
active_abilities.summary: Slow wide oar sweep (prototype 55 damage, 4 m range, 0.85 s attack cycle); telegraphed melee, no permanent stun.

active_abilities.name: Breakwater
active_abilities.summary: Spend Ballast to form a frontal flowing current; hostile ranged hits crossing its plane deal 45% less damage to covered allies and Dreadhull. 20 initial + 30/s; max 2.5 s, 5 s cooldown; melee and flanks bypass.

active_abilities.name: Undertow
active_abilities.summary: Project a marked 7 m water lane; after 0.55 s, enemies within are slowed 30% for 1.5 s and drawn up to 2 m toward the marked landing point. 10 s cooldown, safe landing and line of sight required.

active_abilities.name: Deadman's Mooring
active_abilities.summary: Plant the oar as a visible mooring point for 4 s; allies inside 5 m gain 60% resistance to horizontal knockback, not stun immunity. Dreadhull moves 25% slower and cannot attack while planted. 14 s cooldown; cancel early or interrupt with hard CC.

active_abilities.name: Kraken's Wake
active_abilities.summary: Summon three sequential, clearly marked spectral kraken arms across an 11 m fan. Each lane warns 0.8 s before a single sweep; 65 damage, up to 2 m pull, 35% slow 2 s. Each enemy affected at most once per cast. No physical wall or pit pulls; allies unaffected; prototype 100 ultimate charge cost.

passive.name: Ballast Heart
passive.summary: 100 Ballast maximum, 15/s regeneration after 2 s without spending. Only Breakwater consumes Ballast; no gains from incoming damage, no idle shielding and no health regeneration. Interrupted or empty current ends immediately.
